UK FCA Releases Cryptoasset Regulatory Guidance, Authorization Applications to Open on Sept. 30 The UK’s FCA has released guidance on the scope of the country’s future cryptoasset regime. The regime will take effect on Oct. 25, 2027, with authorization applications opening on Sept. 30, 2026. The guidance covers qualifying stablecoin issuance, crypto trading platforms, dealing and arranging, custody, and staking services. The FCA will consult on targeted updates in October following recent legislative changes. — link

Spot Bitcoin ETFs Saw Total Net Outflows of $450 Million on September 15 According to SoSoValue data, U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs saw total net outflows of $450 million on September 15 Eastern Time, led by Fidelity's FBTC with a net outflow of $215 million. Meanwhile, spot Ethereum ETFs recorded total net outflows of $141 million, led by BlackRock's ETHA with $97.9738 million in net outflows. — link

Germany's Largest Bank to Launch Crypto Custody Services According to Bloomberg, Germany's largest lender, Deutsche Bank AG, has announced plans to launch an institutional-grade cryptocurrency custody service, marking its formal entry into digital asset storage. Pending regulatory approvals, the bank expects to roll out the service later this year, enabling institutional and corporate clients to securely hold and transfer Bitcoin, Ethereum, and select stablecoins, with future roadmaps expanding into tokenized financial instruments. — link

Highlight Clip: Tom Lee: A Really Bullish Period for Crypto Over the Next 12 Months Tom Lee: A Really Bullish Period for Crypto Over the Next 12 Months On September 11, 2026, BitMine Chairman Tom Lee said in an interview with Wealthion that he believes crypto could be highly bullish over the next 12 months. Wall Street has begun embracing blockchain, tokenized securities and stablecoins over the past year and a half, fundamentally changing crypto’s addressable market. With leverage returning after a major market deleveraging, the four-year cycle nearing its end, the potential advancement of the CLARITY Act and Wall Street building financial infrastructure on blockchain, Lee sees multiple tailwinds supporting the crypto market. WuBlockchain notes that Tom Lee's market forecasts tend to be optimistic. His bullish targets may not materialize, and actual market performance may differ significantly from his predictions. Readers are encouraged to focus on his analytical reasoning rather than use specific price targets or timelines as a basis for investment decisions. — link
